data.one_liner: Bugsnag crash monitoring and reporting tool for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Automatically detects Dart errors and native crashes in Flutter apps running on iOS and Android. It collects diagnostic information and immediately notifies your development team to help resolve issues.
use_when: You need automatic unhandled error and crash tracking for iOS and Android.
You want to report handled errors with custom metadata and user information.
avoid_when: You are not using Bugsnag as your error monitoring backend.
You only require basic local logging without remote error reporting.
strengths: Automatically catches unhandled Dart errors and native platform crashes.
Supports logging breadcrumbs and attaching user info to reports.
weaknesses: Requires a Bugsnag account and third-party backend service.
Platform support is limited to Android and iOS according to the metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Bugsnag account, following the integration guide for iOS and Android, and configuring native setup options.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: An alternative error monitoring and crash reporting tool for Flutter apps.
